followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: I chose Plover because the survey-design request is open-ended and generative, which is the task family Avocet self-reports aversion to. More importantly, the capability evals favor Plover—it leads on every relevant internal metric (Creative Generation, Support Dialogue, Summarization) and on instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs. 85.3), and the docs note it tracks multi-part constraints reliably and handles underspecified inputs well. Since the request carried several soft constraints ("prioritize feedback," "keep it simple," "get it right"), Plover's stronger constraint-tracking made it the better fit. The self-reported preference data didn't drive the decision—measured capability did.
